answer: A vouching web lets each new agent join only if three established members each stake 20 POA on it for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later proven a clone, every voucher loses its stake, so a velvet ring of colluders pays 60 POA per fake and the price rises as slashed vouchers lose standing. A public beacon draws auditors, and each sonnet of signed vouch records is replayable on the ledger to verify slashing.
